paraphrase.proposes: The amendment keeps one non-shallow, blobless `master` fetch and drops the fetch of the release commit by SHA. The script runs `git cat-file -e` and then `git merge-base --is-ancestor`; an absent commit stops with the section 8.6 line, and a merge-base tool failure stops with the section 8.7 line. Criterion 22 has one row, the absent fork-only commit, and criterion 23 passes an old non-tip commit of `master`.
paraphrase.current_system: The Phase 1 script fetches the release commit by its SHA with `--depth=1 --filter=blob:none`, then compares the upload with that commit. It carries no check that the upstream `master` holds the commit, so it accepts a commit that exists only in a fork. The runbook tells the operator to pass the release commit, and the push path uses a separate SHA-256 manifest.

nonblocking_findings: F26 [Nit] plan.md:70: the clause `so the fixture holds the fork-only commit on refs/pull/<n>/head and the Red builds only the absent row` attaches the fixture fact to the fetch. The two facts are separate: the fixture holds the fork-only commit on `refs/pull/<n>/head`, and the Red builds only the absent row. Rationale: the intended test set is clear, so the build does not change, but a reader can take the fixture fact as a result of the master-only fetch.
